defs.def: to take sth/sb away from a place 移开；拿开；去掉；从 … 机构开除

ex.s: Why not remove it?
ex.t: 为什么不把它移走呢？

ex.s: are removedB. is to be removed

ex.s: C were to be removedD. was being removed
ex.t: 欢迎来到阿姆斯特丹，欢迎来到MacBike。

ex.s: I had my own bedroom, so I worked on removing things I didn’t need.
ex.t: 我有自己的卧室，所以我着手清理我不需要的东西。

ex.s: I removed the sticky spider-webs that covered her head and wings.
ex.t: 我清除覆盖在她头部和翅膀上的粘性蜘蛛网。

ex.s: If you choose to drop a course you must follow the UCLA procedures for removing it from your schedule.
ex.t: 如果你选择退一门课，你必须遵循UCLA将其从你的课表中移除的程序。

ex.s: By removing the lid.
ex.t: 打开盖子。

ex.s: Remove the references．

ex.s: Remove the skin and place them in plastic bags or containers and freeze.
ex.t: 她的皮肤仍然光滑，头发依然乌黑直顺，慢跑让她保持了苗条和健康。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

ex.s: The white bags were then deflated in about half an hour to lower the sequoia's root ball to the bottom of its hole, The bags were removed, but the metal bars were left with the tree because they rust and degrade over a number of years.
ex.t: 然后白色气囊在约半小时内放气，将红杉根球降到坑底，气囊被取出，但钢条留在树旁，因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

ex.s: As one group of workers carried out the rubbish, another group began removing seats and other theater equipment in preparation for the building’s end.
ex.t: 当一组工人运走垃圾时，另一组工人开始拆除座椅和其他剧院设备，为建筑的终结做准备。

ex.s: Remove the shell of the egg.
ex.t: 去掉鸡蛋的外壳。

ex.s: From childhood on my heart and soul have been full of kindness, but for six years now, I have been forced to remove myself from society, to live life alone.
ex.t: 从童年开始，我的内心和灵魂就充满了善意，但六年来，我被迫脱离社会，独自生活。

ex.s: Experts felt it necessary to come up with a plan to remove all the rabbits from the island.
ex.t: 专家们认为有必要制定一个计划来清除岛上所有的兔子。

ex.s: The bags waiting there were then inflated further to take the weight of the sequoia while the transportation bags were deflated and removed from under the tree.
ex.t: 在接下来的五年里，当地公园服务部门将在巨杉的新家对其进行监测和维护。

ex.s: Removing gender from the picture altogether seems like a simple way to fix this.
ex.t: 把性别完全从画面中剔除，似乎是解决这个问题的简单办法。

ex.s: If people remove food and attractants from their yards and campsites, grizzlies will typically pass by without trouble.
ex.t: 如果人们把食物和引诱物从自家院子和营地清除，灰熊通常会顺利通过而不惹麻烦。

defs.def: to take off clothing, etc. from the body 脱去（衣服等）；摘下

ex.s: Sixteen years  60  (early), Pahlsson had removed the diamond ring  61  (cook) a meal.
ex.t: 十六年____（早）之前，Pahlsson 在____（做）饭时取下了这枚钻石戒指。

defs.def: to get rid of sth unpleasant, dirty, etc; to make sth disappear 去除，排除（污渍、不愉快的事物等）；使消失

ex.s: To make sure your appliance is in fact off, remove the plug from its power supply.
ex.t: 为了确保你的电器确实关闭了，请拔掉电源插头。

ex.s: They provide shade, lower surface temperatures, absorb a surprising amount of airborne carbon, remove tiny pollutants, and provide wildlife habitat along with just plain beauty.
ex.t: 它们提供树荫、降低地表温度、吸收可观的空气中的碳、清除微小污染物，并提供野生动物栖息地，还有纯粹的美的享受。

ex.s: Removing isoprene released by existing trees.
ex.t: 清除现有树木释放的异戊二烯。

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
ex.t: 在周三发表于《Environmental Science & Technology Letters》的一项研究中，中国研究人员发现，将自来水煮沸仅五分钟——冷却后过滤——可去除其中至少80%的微塑料。

ex.s: “We should be looking into upgrading drinking water treatment plants so they remove microplastics.”
ex.t: 我们应该考虑升级饮用水处理厂，以便去除微塑料。

ex.s: There is also research showing that pot plants can clean the air around them by removing harmful gases, such as carbon dioxide.
ex.t: 还有研究表明，盆栽植物可以通过去除二氧化碳等有害气体来净化周围的空气。

ex.s: It’s also thought that these places could help reduce the risk of flooding, remove carbon from the atmosphere and fight climate change, as well as improving the mental health of those living locally.
ex.t: 人们还认为这些地方可以帮助减少洪水风险、从大气中去除碳、应对气候变化，以及改善当地居民的心理健康。

ex.s: remove the sound of commercials
ex.t: 去除广告的声音。

ex.s: When fat and salt     64     (remove) from food, the food tastes as if is missing something.
ex.t: 当脂肪和盐从食物中   64   （去除），食物尝起来像少了什么。

ex.s: Now it was up to the living to remove not only the divisions between North and South, but the boundaries between black and white, and work step by step towards the equality of humankind.
ex.t: 现在，这个责任落在了活着的人身上：不仅要消除南北之间的分裂，还要消除黑人与白人之间的界限，一步步向着人类平等的目标前进。

ex.s: About that time, Tony Inglis’ engineering and transport company got the job to remove phone boxes from the streets and sell them out.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭在1980年代开始消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送到了废品收购站。
